title: Linear Domain and Range
student_objective: I can determine and represent the domain and range of linear functions in mathematical and real-world situations.

lesson_flow.label: Watch Tolux read graphs and contexts
Determine domain and range with Tolux

concept_cards.title: Domain = inputs
concept_cards.content: The domain is the set of x-values the function is allowed to use. On a graph, read domain from left to right.

concept_cards.title: Range = outputs
concept_cards.content: The range is the set of y-values the function produces. On a graph, read range from bottom to top.

concept_cards.title: Pure linear functions
concept_cards.content: A nonvertical linear function y=mx+b with no context restrictions has domain all real numbers and range all real numbers when m≠0.

concept_cards.title: Context can restrict values
concept_cards.content: Time, distance, money, age, and counting situations may restrict inputs or outputs even when the algebraic rule itself allows more values.

concept_cards.title: Endpoints matter
concept_cards.content: Use brackets [ ] for included endpoints and parentheses ( ) for excluded endpoints or infinity.

endpoint_notation.teacher_signal: Student uses the wrong bracket or inequality symbol.

items.prompt: In the ordered pairs {(1,4),(2,6),(3,8)}, state the domain.
items.tutor_behavior: Domain comes from the first coordinates.

solution_steps.explanation: The domain is the set of inputs.

items.prompt: In the ordered pairs {(1,4),(2,6),(3,8)}, state the range.
items.tutor_behavior: Range comes from the second coordinates.

solution_steps.explanation: The range is the set of outputs.

items.prompt: State the domain and range of y=2x-5 with no context restrictions.
accepted_answers: domain all real numbers, range all real numbers
items.tutor_behavior: A nonvertical line extends forever left/right and up/down.
hint_steps: Any real x can be substituted.
Because slope 2 is nonzero, outputs also cover all real values.

solution_steps.explanation: The line accepts every real input.
A nonzero slope produces every real output.

items.prompt: A taxi fare is modeled by C=3+2.5m for 0≤m≤20. State the contextual domain.
items.tutor_behavior: Use the stated mileage restriction, not all real numbers.

solution_steps.explanation: The context restricts the input miles.

items.prompt: For y=4x+1 restricted to -2≤x≤3, state the range.
items.tutor_behavior: Evaluate the included domain endpoints because the line is increasing.

solution_steps.explanation: The increasing line covers every y-value between them.

items.prompt: State the domain of y=-3x+7 with no context restrictions.
items.tutor_behavior: A standard nonvertical linear function accepts every real x.
hint_steps: There is no denominator or square root restriction.
The line continues forever left and right.

items.prompt: A savings account model A=50+10w is used for whole weeks 0 through 12. State the contextual domain.
items.tutor_behavior: Whole weeks make the domain discrete, not continuous.
hint_steps: The variable w counts whole weeks.
Use only whole-number inputs from 0 to 12.

items.prompt: For y=-2x+6 restricted to 1≤x≤5, state the range.
items.tutor_behavior: A negative slope reverses which endpoint gives the larger output.

items.prompt: A temperature model T=70-3h is used for 0≤h<8. State the domain in interval notation.
For y=5x-2 restricted to -1<x≤4, state the range.
items.tutor_behavior: The increasing line preserves endpoint openness and closedness.
hint_steps: At x=-1, y=-7, but x=-1 is excluded.
At x=4, y=18, and x=4 is included.

items.prompt: A parking garage charges C=6+2h for 1≤h≤10 whole hours. State the contextual range.
items.tutor_behavior: Discrete whole-hour inputs create discrete cost outputs.
hint_steps: Each additional whole hour adds 2 dollars.

items.prompt: State the domain of y=7x+4 with no context restrictions.
items.tutor_behavior: A nonvertical linear function accepts every real x.

items.prompt: State the range of y=-4x+9 with no context restrictions.
items.tutor_behavior: A nonzero slope gives all real outputs.
hint_steps: The line extends forever vertically as x varies.

items.prompt: For y=3x+2 restricted to 0≤x≤6, state the range.

solution_steps.explanation: The increasing line fills the interval.

items.prompt: A machine operates for 0<t≤5 hours. State the domain in interval notation.
For y=-5x+1 restricted to -2≤x<3, state the range.
items.tutor_behavior: With negative slope, the right input endpoint gives the lower output and the left input endpoint gives the upper output.

solution_steps.explanation: This lower boundary is approached but not included.
Write outputs from least to greatest.
